title: Brand & Marketing Executive
description:
The Role:

We're looking for a creative and organised Brand & Marketing Executive to join our Marketing team on a maternity cover basis. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in protecting and developing our brand, creating engaging content, and supporting our social media activity across multiple channels.

Working closely with colleagues, agencies and external partners, you'll help bring our brand to life through compelling visual content, effective campaign support and strong brand governance.

You'll also provide valuable support in the planning and coordination of key events, ensuring projects are delivered to a high standard and aligned with our brand values.

This role would suit someone with a strong eye for detail, a passion for brand and content, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Please note this is a maternity cover position until October 2027.

What you'll be doing:
- Act as a brand guardian, ensuring consistency and quality across all marketing and communications activity.
- Manage creative briefs and coordinating artwork and marketing assets with agency and creative partners.
- Support the development and delivery of marketing campaigns through brand, creative and social media activity.
- Manage organic social media channels and working closely with our specialist equine social media agency to coordinate content and activity.
- Support photography, video and other content creation projects to help showcase our products, people and brand.
- Maintain and organise the image and asset library, ensuring content is accessible and up to date.
- Create simple marketing assets and artwork using Canva and other design tools where appropriate.
- Support the planning, coordination and administration of key events, helping to ensure successful delivery.
- Build effective relationships with internal stakeholders, agencies and suppliers to deliver high-quality marketing outputs.

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in a brand, marketing, content or social media role.
- A strong understanding of brand management and an excellent eye for visual detail.
- Experience creating and managing content across social media platforms.
- Confidence using Canva to create visually engaging marketing materials.
- Experience briefing and working with creative agencies, designers or external suppliers.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- A proactive, hands-on approach and willingness to support across a broad range of marketing activities.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with colleagues across different teams.
- An interest in or knowledge of the equine sector would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Why Agria Pet Insurance:

AgrIa Pet Insurance is one of the UK's leading specialist pet insurance providers. We only provide lifetime insurance for animals, so truly understand and care about our customers and their beloved pets - especially as most of our team are pet parents, and we're all animal-lovers. Our passion for pets means that we are trusted by The Royal Kennel Club, Lloyds and many other significant affinity partners to provide lifetime pet insurance in their names.

Working closely with animal welfare organisations, vets and breeders, gives us deep insight on what's best for pets. And we give back too - including supporting hundreds of animal rescues, protecting over 100,000 rescued animals, and through donations of over £2m to animal charities.

We are a strong, growing business, having doubled our GWP in the last 5 years, with a supportive ethos and family feel. We became one of the UK s Best Workplaces in 2023, 2024, 2025 and again in 2026, we have the top 4 slots on Which? Best Buy pet insurance, are ranked 4.8 on Trustpilot (higher than any other pet insurance provider) and we are extremely proud to be the only carbon negative pet insurer in the UK.

What we offer:
- 25 days annual leave which increases with service, plus bank holidays and an extra day off for your Birthday!
- Opportunity to buy/sell up to 5 days annual leave per calendar year
- Pension and Life Assurance scheme
- Access to 25% off insuring your pet with Agria. Friends and family are also entitled to a discount too
- We aim to support the health and wellbeing of all our colleagues so you ll have access to a Health Cash Plan, mental health support and health and wellbeing platforms, including Headspace

Please note, we operate a hybrid working model, with colleagues attending our Aylesbury office every Wednesday and working remotely for the remainder of the week.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Specialist

Contract until 31 December 2027 initially, with potential for extension

35 Hours per week, Monday - Friday 09:00-17:00

Milton Keynes, Hybrid - 3 days on site 2 days from home

19.23- 21.98 ( 35,000 - 40,000)

The opportunity

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced and commercially minded Digital Marketing Specialist to join a leading premium automotive organisation.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing - Media, you will play a key role in supporting the planning, delivery and optimisation of high-profile national marketing campaigns.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong understanding of paid media, broadcast advertising and integrated media campaigns. You will work across a variety of channels, helping to deliver impactful brand campaigns, support key product launches and drive customer engagement and sales opportunities.

This role requires practical experience of paid media and broadcast campaigns. We are particularly interested in candidates who understand media planning, buying and campaign performance, rather than those whose experience is primarily organic social media or content creation.

Key responsibilities
- Support the planning, development and delivery of integrated national media campaigns across digital, paid social, broadcast, video-on-demand (VOD), outdoor and experiential channels.
- Work closely with media agencies, creative agencies and external partners to deliver impactful campaigns aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
- Support paid media planning and execution, ensuring campaigns are targeted effectively and budgets are used efficiently.
- Contribute to the delivery of key product launches and brand campaigns.
- Monitor campaign performance, analysing key metrics and providing recommendations to improve effectiveness, reach and return on investment.
- Use analytics, reporting dashboards and performance data to identify insights and optimise campaigns.
- Work collaboratively with internal stakeholders across Product, Sales, PR and Marketing.
- Ensure brand consistency and make effective use of centrally supplied creative assets.
- Prepare campaign reports, presentations and performance updates for senior stakeholders.
- Support media budget management, including purchase orders, invoice processing, accruals and financial administration.
- Keep up to date with developments in paid media, broadcast advertising, digital platforms and emerging media opportunities.

Skills and experience required

Essential experience:
- Proven experience in digital marketing, media planning or campaign management.
- Strong practical understanding of paid media, including paid digital advertising and paid social campaigns.
- Experience working with broadcast media, television advertising and/or video-on-demand (VOD) campaigns.
- Understanding of media planning, media buying, audience targeting and campaign delivery.
- Experience working with media agencies, creative agencies and external partners.
- Strong analytical skills, with experience measuring campaign performance and reporting on ROI.
- Understanding of the customer journey and how different media channels work together.
- Excellent organisation and project management skills.
- Strong communication and presentation skills.

Desirable experience:
- Experience within the automotive, luxury or premium consumer goods sector.
- Experience supporting national brand campaigns and major product launches.
- Knowledge of media budgets, purchase orders, invoices and financial administration.
- Experience using campaign analytics and reporting platforms.

The ideal candidate

The ideal candidate will be a commercially aware marketer who understands how paid media works across multiple channels and can confidently support the delivery of large-scale marketing campaigns.

You will be comfortable working with media agencies, interpreting campaign data, managing multiple projects and contributing to strategic media decisions.

You will be proactive, analytical, detail-oriented and able to thrive in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Candidates with experience across paid media and broadcast advertising are strongly encouraged to apply. Experience limited to organic social media management or content creation will not be sufficient for this position.

title: International Marketing Operations Manager
description:
International Marketing Operations Manager

Job Type: Temporary
Location: Marlow (hybrid working available)
Duration: 12 months

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced International Marketing Operations Manager to lead and optimise promotional review processes across international markets. This role will act as a key partner to marketing, medical, legal, regulatory and compliance stakeholders, ensuring the efficient review, approval and management of promotional materials for pharmaceutical and/or medical device products. The successful candidate will combine strong project management expertise with a thorough understanding of MLR processes, compliance requirements and promotional review systems to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead and facilitate cross-functional Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR) review meetings, managing agendas, stakeholder feedback and approval workflows.
- Manage promotional review activities for assigned brands, ensuring materials progress efficiently through review and approval stages.
- Act as a subject matter expert for promotional review processes and systems, supporting users and driving adherence to company procedures and industry regulations.
- Collaborate closely with marketing, medical, regulatory, compliance and operational teams to ensure timely preparation, submission and approval of promotional materials.
- Lead process improvement initiatives and special projects to enhance review efficiency, materials management and operational effectiveness.
- Analyse process performance, identify opportunities for innovation and support wider Marketing Operations projects and business initiatives.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, with a minimum of 5 years' experience within pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences marketing operations.
- Strong understanding of MLR review processes, promotional compliance requirements and pharmaceutical advertising regulations, including ABPI guidance.
- Experience working with promotional review platforms such as Veeva PromoMats or similar content management and approval systems.
- Demonstrated project management experience with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to tight deadlines.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and meeting facilitation skills with experience working across international cross-functional teams.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook, with the ability to analyse data and produce clear business communications.

What's on Offer

This is an excellent opportunity to join a highly collaborative global organisation, where you will play a pivotal role in driving compliant promotional excellence, influencing international stakeholders and leading initiatives that improve marketing operations across multiple markets.

To Apply

If you want to find out more about this role or would like to make an application, click below or contact Theo Charles

title: Trustee - Communications, Marketing and PR
description:
Communications, Marketing & PR Trustee (voluntary)

Location: Aston Sandford, Bucks HP17 8 JB with travel across Thames Valley and occasionally further afield

Time Commitment: 5-6 days Per Year

Hope After Harm is a Buckinghamshire based registered Charity and Charitable Company Limited by Guarantee of 32 years' operating a range of support programmes across the Thames Valley - including support for victims, support for the families of offenders, early interventions, work in the field of domestic abuse and support to offenders. With 40 staff and approximately 30 volunteers, a solid Trustee framework is essential to underpin and inform our work and our Trustees currently bring together considerable experience from criminal justice, local government, the corporate and voluntary sectors.

We have a very exciting vacancy we wish to fill, to complement our existing Board and guide our successful and growing organisation into the next phase of development. This is an opportunity to use your professional skills to support a charity delivering meaningful impact across the Thames Valley.

Hope After Harm is relatively small, trustees can see the direct results of their contribution and frontline impact, we require general Trustee experience, to expand the knowledge base and help strengthen the Board overall, we are also specifically looking for those with experience in the following areas:

For the Marketing, Communications and PR Trustee position, your role will be:
- Advise the Board on communications, media, marketing and reputation matters.
- Provide strategic oversight of Hope After Harm's brand, profile and public positioning.
- Offer constructive challenge on communications risks, including reputation, safeguarding, confidentiality and data protection.
- Support the Board to consider how communications can strengthen awareness, stakeholder confidence, fundraising and community engagement.
- Provide guidance on the charity's approach to public statements, media interest and crisis communications.
- Champion communications that are sensitive to the experiences of survivors, families, young people and others affected by harm and trauma.
- Work with the CEO and staff team in an advisory capacity to support effective delivery

Person specification

The trustee should bring senior-level knowledge or experience across a number of the following areas:
- Public relations, media relations and strategic communications
- Brand management and brand consistency
- Crisis communications and reputation management
- Stakeholder engagement and public engagement
- Social media strategy and digital communications
- Content development across online and offline channels
- Awareness campaigns and community outreach
- Communications governance, including tone of voice, messaging and reputational risk

The successful candidate does not need to be an expert in every area, but should be able to provide strategic insight, constructive challenge and proportionate assurance to support the charity's work.

Time Commitment

The Trustee will be expected to attend Board Meetings 4 times a year (face to face) and also attend one committee meeting (Teams) 4 times a year, as well as attending a strategy day. The time commitment including meeting preparation is estimated to be 5-6 days per annum

Location

Ideally, the post-holder will be able to travel to Aston Sandford and possibly other places in the Thames Valley for meetings, but we would consider remote attendance, with the exception of a requirement for face-to-face attendance at the annual Board strategy day

If you have a passion and commitment to support a value-driven organisation, strategic vision, independent judgement and a willingness to devote the necessary time and effort we would be delighted to hear from you. Any travel and out of pocket expenses will be reimbursed but please note this is a voluntary and unpaid post.

Application Process:

Please email covering letter expressing your interest, with a CV of your skills.
